title: Start Claude successors with bypassPermissions
body:
Outcome: every Claude successor started by scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts runs with --permission-mode bypassPermissions, so a relayed lead never stops on permission prompts or the auto-mode classifier. Operator 2026-11-06: "Masz bypassed permissions ... ogarnij opcje 1 do successor launch" (standing grants: .krn/runs/program-audit/grant.md, memory full-project-control-grant).
Proof: test/claude/successor-launch.test.ts launches a stub named claude through Herdr and the --bg fallback and sees --permission-mode bypassPermissions; a non-claude agent gets no extra flags.
